description: This file contains integration tests for the 'LoanChargeProgressive' feature within the Apache Fineract project. It extends base test classes and defines setup, test cases, and teardown logic for validating progressive loan charge behaviors, specifically focusing on charges after maturity and immediate charge accrual.

classes.name: LoanChargeProgressiveTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending BaseLoanIntegrationTest, containing setup, test cases, and cleanup for testing progressive loan charge behavior.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up a client, loan product, and disbursed loan with specific parameters before each test.

methods.name: loanChargeAfterMaturityTest
methods.description: Tests the application of a loan charge after the loan's maturity date.

methods.name: immediateChargeAccrualPostMaturityTest
methods.description: Tests the immediate accrual of charges post maturity with configuration toggles.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Resets configuration settings after each test.
